root_cause.detail: The exact raid cleared the full five-target prerequisite corridor and reached the Magmaw node. Native threat snapshots then contained Magmaw GUID 39 plus encounter-linked actors 205-208, and all ten per-bot snapshots transitioned to alive=false at the Magmaw anchor. BotWorldPopulationMgr::EnsurePopulation validated the completed immutable admission on every tick and returned without invoking EnsureValidationCohortGroup, so RaidRuntime remained frozen at its admission snapshot: alive_size 10, encounter_in_progress false, evidence_sequence 0, and zero wipe/reset/recovery generations. The native-full-wipe-only policy therefore correctly held on native_full_wipe_wait_unlatched until the semantic watchdog stopped the run.
root_cause.decision_assessment: The cohort-consistent corridor remediation behaved correctly and eliminated the prior tactical-retreat split. At Magmaw, real target/threat and deaths were visible to bot diagnostics, but the frozen raid-runtime bridge prevented authoritative encounter and recovery decisions. Reconcile exact live raid state every completed-admission tick before evaluating recovery; do not manufacture engagement, deaths, boss state, resurrection, teleport, or ready-check evidence.
remediation_scope: refresh the exact immutable raid runtime after successful completed-admission identity validation
preserve native release/runback far-worldport deferral and refresh again after exact reattachment
preserve terminal identity-drift cleanup without refreshing an invalid cohort
independently review, rebuild, reprovision, and rerun uncapped before accepting Phase 1
review the native Magmaw script events and every bot decision after the evidence bridge is live

acceptance.reason: The live raid-runtime bridge froze at admission, so native Magmaw engagement, full wipe, reset, per-GUID recovery, and ready-check ordering were not reconstructable.
acceptance.next_gate: Bounded live-runtime refresh remediation, mandatory independent Sol-high review, exact coordinated rebuild, fresh provisioning/full verifier/v4 readback, and uncapped canonical rerun.
